RagShortTexts: After the unification of the empire, the controversy over the move of Saniopa back to Lycaron

Variants.Content: Saneopa is the capital of the empire. I heard that the capital has now been moved to Lycaron.
Sanieopa is our glorious imperial capital. Although it was moved to Lycaron after Nereitses, this is only temporary. When the empire is unified, we will move back to Sanieopa. Probably?

Saneopa is the traditional imperial capital. It has been more than three hundred years since we moved the capital here from Palavinos, but the hateful Emperor Neretses—I don’t even want to call him emperor—made our Majesty Arenicos have to move the capital to Lycaron, which has now caused the empire to be divided. If the empire is reunited, we still hope to move the imperial capital back to Sanjeopa

Although the imperial capital is great, we live better in our own fiefdom. We never want to move the capital back to Saniopa, because if we move back, all the power we cultivated in the new capital will be lost.
